scores.evidence: Objectives are unchanged, and every reworded question still assesses its objectiveId with the same key: q1 (o1) b, q2 (o2) c, q7 (o3) b, q9 (o2) b, q6 (o1) b, q5 (o2) b, q4 (o3) b. The reworded keys say the same thing as before (q4-b 「ファイルはできたが、サーバーにはまだない」 instead of 「まだ送っていない」), so each question still tests what it did.

hook-b1 is unchanged. In q0 the options were lengthened, not changed in meaning: c 「AIが、入力されたタスクを覚えていないから」 still voices the beginner belief its feedback corrects, and the key b 「データを保存する仕組みが、アプリにないから」 now also matches the feedback's 「アプリの仕組みです」.

The コミット definition in s4-b2 and the glossary now reads 「その時点のファイル全体の状態を、変更の説明（メッセージ）と一緒に、Gitに記録することです。」, identical in both places, still after s4-analogy (「1回ごとのセーブがコミット」), and consistent with s4-prompt-commit's 「Gitにコミットしてください」. The other analogies and definitions are unchanged.

validate and lint --strict are clean; the edits add a few characters per item (「まず、」, 「、Gitに」, 「ほんの少しだけ」) and no new terms or sentences, every changed sentence stays under 60 characters. 1-2 remains the crowded segment it was (UI, API and JSON, an analogy, a tip, JSON code, two prompts and q2), so the score stays at 3.

ex-steps is unchanged; q9 still fades step ④ onto 期限, and option a now reads 「一覧の各タスクに期限の日付を表示して。APIとデータベースは変えないで」, matching its English "in the list", so the faded step keeps the same contrast with the key b 「期限を保存し、一覧のAPIでも返して。画面はまだ変えないで」.

Every content section still has its inline check (q1, q2, q7, q8, q9) with feedback on every wrong option. The rewording does not make a key stand out: the key is the shortest or tied in q1 (b 19 chars), q2 (c 19), q7 (b 20 of 20–21), q6 and q4 (20 of up to 22), and the padding went into distractors as often as into keys (q1 c/d, q2 a, q7 d, q6 c, q5 c, q4 d).

The reworded distractors encode the same misconceptions and keep their feedback unchanged and still fitting: q0-c (the AI keeps the data), q7-d 「画面のデザインを、もう一度最初から作り直す」 (looks fix availability), q6-c 「データベースを、別の種類のものに入れ替える」 (the database decides), q5-c (a display change taken for an API change), q4-d 「サーバーが起動して、もう依頼を待ち受けている」 (a build means it is live).
s1-b2 is unchanged (4 nodes, labels matching the terms, takeaway caption and alt), and the deploy stages stay a numbered list in s3-b2; the only change there is 「ビルド：まず、公開用のファイル一式を作ります。」.

pc-input now reads 「画面側の依頼に、読み終えた日の入力とAPIでの保存が書いてあります」, the same criterion as before and still checkable against practice-answer-ui; the transfer task, expects and model answers are unchanged. The hint ladder is still two levels (hint → troubleshoot), not the three of anchor 4.

summary-points (4) comes after the exam, summary-next asks a reflection question (「UIとAPIのどちらの変更か考えてみましょう」) and names the next step (第2章), and summary-ask offers tutor prompts. cards has 7 retrieval cards, and the changed fronts match the text (「デプロイの3つの段階は？」 as in s3-flow).

The changed claims stay within their cited sources: コミット 「…Gitに記録すること」 (git-commit), q4-b 「ファイルはできたが、サーバーにはまだない」 after a build 「自分のパソコンで」 (mdn-deployment), and q7-b/s3-b2 「依頼に答えられる」 (mdn-server-side, mdn-express-intro). No menu, button or shortcut is introduced. s3-b2's added 「まず、」 restates the order the numbered list already gives for a build on your own computer (see niceToHave).

です・ま す and the warm tone are kept and lint is clean; the reworded options stay plain-form option fragments as before. Still left for the ja-editor: hook-b1's 「頼むと、画面はすぐにできました」, q1-b's causative 「保存させる」, and 1-5's データ側/画面側 beside フロントエンド and UI; the padding words added for line breaks (「きちんと」「ほんの少しだけ」「いまの」) are wording the ja-editor owns.

Every changed field keeps jp and en, and where the meaning shifted the English was updated with it (q4-b "are not on the server yet", q4-d "The server has started…", q7-d "again from scratch", コミット "in Git"); q9-a's Japanese now says 「一覧の」 as its English already did. Only s2-prompt-api's English keeps quotes the Japanese dropped (niceToHave).

niceToHave: s3-b2: the added 「まず、」 restates build-first, which round 2 softened in s3-flow because some hosts build on their side (mdn-publishing). The numbered list already gives the order, so the word adds nothing; a replacement of the same length without it: 「ビルド：公開するためのファイル一式を作ります。」 (en unchanged).

s2-prompt-api: the Japanese dropped the brackets around the placeholder, but the English still reads "Add \"{{field to add}}\" to the API…". To match the Japanese and s2-prompt-ui's English: "Add {{field to add}} to the API that returns the task list. If the database has nowhere to store it, add that too. Keep the existing fields as they are, and do not change how the screen looks."

hook-predict q0: the key b 「データを保存する仕組みが、アプリにないから」 (21 characters) is now the longest Japanese option by one character (a and c are 20). It is ungraded and the gap is small, but if a line-break fix is needed anyway, 「保存する仕組みが、アプリにないから」 keeps the meaning and is no longer the longest.
summary: Verification round (review-scope.mjs exit 0: 11 of 94 parts changed, 12%, sections and objectives unchanged); validate and lint --strict are clean. The previous round had no open must-fix items, so there is nothing to resolve. All 10 changed blocks and the glossary were reviewed in full: the 15 rewordings keep every key, objectiveId and misconception, no key became a giveaway in a graded question, the コミット definition and glossary entry agree, and s2-prompt-api now matches s2-prompt-ui. No new must-fix; scores are unchanged (mean 3.77). Small notes: 「まず、」 in s3-b2, the English quotes in s2-prompt-api, and q0's key now being one character longer.
